# Two AI Stock Rotations

Report 173 | Published 2025-10-12 | Evaluated 2026-11-07

[Original member article](https://www.lynalden.com/premium-2025-10-12/) | [Article index](README.md) | [Structured review](../data/reviews/173.json)

Rotate AI exposure toward services and payments.

The new positions suffered adverse one-year price sensitivities while the sold chip stocks kept rising, although the author explicitly avoided calling tops. PayPal support failed, and Fiserv soon disclosed substantive deterioration. Accenture earnings growth supported the business thesis without producing a positive first-year stock return.

**Coverage:** All numbered text blocks and image labels read. Material theses, forecasts and explanations are included; routine holdings lists, incidental statistics, company descriptions and boilerplate are excluded. Chart pixels were not inspected.

## Claims

### 173-C01

**China has bargaining leverage**

| Field | Assessment |

| Type | explanation |
| Horizon | Not specified |
| Conditions | Not specified |
| Author modality | asserted |
| Asset or variable | US China trade |

Rare-earth refining concentration supports the material-dependence argument. It does not prove inevitable negotiating success, exact replication costs, or that all trading relationships favor China equally.

**Direction:** See reason; no return inferred.

**Timing:** No fixed endpoint supplied.

**Mechanism:** Outcome evidence does not independently identify causation.

**Reviewer confidence:** medium

**Outcome evidence:**

- [Rare-earth supply concentration and export controls](https://www.iea.org/commentaries/with-new-export-controls-on-critical-minerals-supply-concentration-risks-become-reality) | IEA | Verified in the audit

China accounted for about 91% of rare-earth separation/refining; October 9, 2025 controls covered products, equipment and technologies. Concentration creates bargaining leverage, without guaranteeing each negotiated concession.

## Framework lessons

- A profitable business can be an unprofitable purchase.

## Verification limitations

- Retrieved 2026-11-07; publication-date wording is not authenticated.
- Public market series are available, but not every investment claim has a defined horizon or reconciled corporate-action-adjusted return. Unverified outcomes remain unscored; macro data use latest available vintages.
